newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Britain sign double taxation protocol.
newsitem.headline: China, Britain sign double taxation protocol.

text.p: China and Britain signed a protocol on double taxation on Monday, officials of the two governments said.
The protocol amends an earlier tax accord and extends tax sparing treatment to companies of both countries.
That ensures that firms from one country receiving a tax holiday on investments in the other country are considered as having paid tax by their home government.
Chinese officials said that the accord, although reciprocal, would mainly affect British companies investing in China.

The protocol was signed at a brief ceremony attended by Jeremy Hanley, visiting British Minister of State at the Foreign and Commonwealth Office, and Xiang Huaicheng, Party Group Secretary of China's State General Administration of Taxation.
